title: galium × ochroleucum var. approximatum
intro: Galium × ochroleucum var. approximatum, commonly known as Galium approximatum, is a hybrid plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in Europe. The health benefits of Galium approximatum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infection, and promote tissue repair, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
